`SyntheticFixtureTests` verifies `F1-SWO-001.pdf` against `SyntheticPdf.CanonicalFixture()`, and F2 fixture integrity tests verify the committed byte lengths, SHA-256 digests, and strict `PdfPigAdmission` compatibility of all three committed product test fixtures. Negative/profile-boundary PDFs (encrypted, malformed, truncated, `4`-page and `51`-page documents) are generated deterministically in memory via `SyntheticPdf.Build(...)`. No holdout (`F03`, `F05`, `F06`, `F08`) or customer PDFs are present.
